name: Tran Quoc Pagoda
kicker: The pagoda on the West Lake shore
summary: The pagoda stands on the West Lake shore, with the stupa above the water. A fee and a clock appear on a single airline page. That page is not used as the published gate time. The fee and the hours are check on arrival.
getThere: On the West Lake shore. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The stupa of Tran Quoc Pagoda above the water
gettingThere: Tran Quoc is on the shore of West Lake, in Tay Ho. No published minute count from Hoan Kiem was opened from an operator page. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. A single airline page is not used as the fee or the clock.
